title: Characterize a SKY130 Inverter
scope: 18 actual SKY130 transistor benches, each with DC and transient analysis.
outputs: DC transfer, delay/slew, supply current/energy; comparison with archived Liberty.

title: Bias, Gain & Startup
scope: 35 nominal SKY130 MOS benches plus six explicitly behavioral startup benches.
outputs: Mirror compliance, gm/gds, amplifier AC/transient response, ramps and brownout.

title: Sampling Switches & Reference Loading
scope: 57 ideal/MOS acquisition benches and three assumed reference-load RLC benches.
outputs: Pre/post-opening errors, hold change, source impedance, reference ripple and recovery.

title: Geometry, Parasitics & Probe Mapping
scope: Four teaching geometries, eight actual RC-network SPICE transients, refinement and independent solver checks.
tools: Python; ngspice or built-in numerical solver
outputs: RC networks, geometry images, coordinate/probe maps, delay, coupling, and mismatch.

title: Mixed-Signal Integration Across Clocks & Power Events
scope: Three digital clock configurations, a deliberate failing negative control, and a separate mapped/equivalent RTL example.
tools: Python and Icarus Verilog; optional Yosys/ABC
outputs: Self-checking transactions, accepted/delivered/aborted counts, restart tests, and synthesis evidence.
